value.name: Asha silently decides about Devin
value.description: Asha withholds her decision about Devin verbally, leaving Rosa to infer the answer from her silence.
evidence: She did not say what she had decided about Devin, and Rosa did not ask again; the phone sat between them with his name still at the top of the thread, and that was apparently enough to count as an answer for now.

value.name: Asha pockets the phone in her briefcase
value.description: Asha takes the phone on her own terms and puts it in the outside pocket of her briefcase before leaving.
evidence: Asha picked it up, this time on her own terms, and slipped it into the outside pocket of the briefcase where she would feel it against her hip on the way to the car.

value.name: Asha closes the briefcase and stands to leave
value.description: Asha shuts the briefcase, rises from the table, and prepares to go.
evidence: Asha closed the briefcase latches one after the other, each click smaller than the last, and stood.

value.name: Rosa yields the doorway without protest
value.description: As Asha moves toward the door, Rosa steps aside and lets her pass without forcing the issue.
evidence: She did not look at Rosa as she came around the table, only at the doorway past her, and Rosa stepped aside without making her ask.

value.name: Rosa resumes quiet kitchen work
value.description: After Asha leaves the table, Rosa returns to drying dishes in her habitual slow, even manner.
evidence: Behind her, Rosa picked up the dish towel from where she had folded it on her wrist and went to the counter, lifting a wet glass from the rack and beginning to dry it in the same slow, even motion she used for everything else in this kitchen.

value.name: Asha leaves the house
value.description: Asha exits through the front door, hearing Rosa continue drying dishes behind her.
evidence: The sound of the towel against the glass followed Asha down the hall, steady enough that she could hear it past the front door as she pulled it shut

value.name: Asha realizes Rosa will wait and watch
value.description: Asha understands that Rosa will not press her again but will instead wait to see what she does.
evidence: and she understood, the way she had understood the phone sliding across the table, that Rosa was not going to ask her again what she had decided, only wait to see what she did.

value.name: Asha drives east toward her destination
value.description: Asha heads east in her car with the briefcase secured beside her, continuing the scene beyond the house.
evidence: Asha drove east with both hands on the wheel and the briefcase belted into the passenger seat
